author: Ben Janca
description: Dragon's Dogma 2: Dark Arisen comes to the Nintendo Switch 2 this month. Here's how Capcom's fantasy adventure holds on the handheld.
title: Should You Play Dragon’s Dogma 2 On Switch 2?

author: Ashley Bardhan
description:
The Remothered games are true cult classics in the way that players find them either insufferable or inspired. As a lover of developer Stormind Games' antique perversions, but also a hater of its convoluted storytelling, I regretfully exist somewhere in between. But I know I won't be able to resist the new Remothered: Red Nun's Legacy when it launches later this month, since the horror game legends who helped make the Italian gothic game are way too good. Red Nun’s Legacy will feature legendary Silent Hill composer Akira Yamaoka, and its Red Nun enemy is voiced by Resident Evil alumna Maggie Robertson.

Remothered: Red Nun's Legacy latest trailer, which premiered today during the latest Horror Game Awards showcase, revels in the weathered stone buildings and marb
title: Controversial Horror Series Ropes Me Back In With Silent Hill’s Original Composer And Lady Dimitrescu

author: Mark Delaney
description:
The Outlast Trials, Red Barrels' co-op horror game set in its wider Outlast universe, just broke its concurrent-player record, eclipsing 120,000 players. The previous high came when the game launched in Steam Early Access in 2023 and the player count climbed to 36,000. 

Today's new record means the indie horror game reset the bar with a total more than four times higher than its previous best.

Red Barrels credited a few big factors for the record. For one, The Outlast Trials is enjoying a huge discount in the Steam Autumn Sale, on sale for $4--though that sale ends tomorrow (Thursday, October 8), if you're interested.
title: Three Years Later, The Outlast Trials Just Smashed Its Concurrent-Player Record

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
Zach Cregger has another hit on his hands with Resident Evil, and it's set to become his biggest movie ever by revenue at the box office.

According to Deadline, Resident Evil is expected to surpass his current biggest movie, Weapons ($270 million worldwide), by the end of this week or sooner. It currently stands at $247.6 million worldwide.

What's propelling Resident Evil higher was its release in China this week--it debuted there on October 5, and
title: Resident Evil Movie Will Become Zach Cregger’s Biggest Ever, Surpassing Weapons

author: Cameron Koch
description:
What likely would have been the big new enemy faction of the Halo universe, the Endless, have been fully revealed, though it's unclear what role, if any, they will play going forward.

As announced last month by Xbox's Matt Booty, Halo is under new management, with the responsibility of the next game in the series going to a completely new team under Activision. Halo Studios, formerly 343 Industries, will remain as a small team to oversee already-released titles like the recent Halo: Campaign Evolved. However, the majority of the studio, 268 people, have been laid off.

In the wake of the news, the latest (and now last) issue of the lore-focused
title: What’s Next For Halo Under Activision? Probably Not The Endless

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
007 First Light is already out, but it's still accumulating wishlists on Steam, and now that it's passed 7 million wishlists, a very good boy has been added to the game.

With 7 million wishlists, IO Interactive has added Jack the bulldog to the game via its TacSim lobby for everyone. Jack, as a statue model, made his James Bond debut in the 2012 movie Skyfall, sitting on M's desk. The statue survived when the office exploded, though its face got cracked and Union Jack flag was charred. Jack went on to appear in Spectre and No Time To Die. Now, he's alive, and he's in First Light.
title: 007 First Light Players Unlock A Very Good Boy

author: Mark Delaney
description:
The Horror Game Awards ceremony kicks off in November, but the team's latest showcase event has arrived, highlighting 100+ horror games. The latest showing, Harvest of Terror, is the brand's first event since June's Midsummer Night's Scream showcase. 

As I did for that summer show, I watched every trailer featured in today's event and pulled out a handful of those I'm particularly excited about.

I purposely didn't call out games already featured in my summer horror showcase recap or my Oc
title: 14 Horror Games It Would Be Terrifying Not To Wishlist

author: Gabe Gurwin
description:
Star Wars Zero Company released in late August to great reviews, but its launch was bittersweet, as a large chunk of developer Bit Reactor's staff was furloughed, unsure if they would be returning to work. For at least a portion of them, however, that uncertainty is over, as they're back at the studio.

Speaking to Game File, Bit Reactor CEO Greg Foertsch said the studio had "started the process of returning more of our team back to work" but stopped short of giving specific perc
title: Star Wars Zero Company Developer Sees Portion Of Furloughed Workers Return

author: Tomas Franzese
description:
Paradox Interactive has announced Cities: Skylines - Expanded Edition, a Nintendo Switch 2 port of Colossal Order's hit 2015 city-builder. While it's great to see Cities: Skylines make its way to a new platform, this announcement also serves as a reminder that we have no idea when the long-awaited console ports of Cities: Skylines 2 will come out.

Cities: Skylines - Expanded Edition was developed by Tantalus Media, the team behind The Legend of Zelda: Skyward Sword's Switch port. It'll cost $49, include 10 expansions, expand the buildable area to 25 tiles, support keyboard and mouse, and add a map editor, plus better precision placement and environmental controls. P
title: Cities: Skylines Announced For Switch 2 While Sequel’s Console Ports Are Still MIA

author: Cameron Koch
description:
World of Warcraft: Forever players have made their feelings about the game's visual style crystal clear: They love it when things look old.

It's a recurring theme in the Forever beta, where players have continually pushed back against updated high-definition character models and character portraits. While Forever is in many ways a new version of Blizzard's MMORPG, it's built with the spirit and foundation of WoW Classic in mind, even as it includes updated visuals and quality-of-life updates taken straight from modern WoW. One of those new features is an option to use modern WoW's updated playable character and non-enemy NPC models.

According to the WoW content creator Savix, who tested an early version of Forever before it was publicly
title: WoW: Forever Players Love It When Things Look Old

author: Ben Janca
description:
Cyclops is ready to unleash his Optic Blasts and the cosmic flames of the Phoenix on the battlefield!

Build Solar Shards to harness the power of the Phoenix, and balance extraordinary strength against the path to destruction.
Embrace the power of the Phoenix when Cyclops joins MARVEL Tōkon: Fighting Souls on November 2!

MARVEL Tōkon: Fighting Souls is available now on PS5 and PC!
title: MARVEL Tokon: Fighting Souls – Phoenix Cyclops Gameplay Reveal Trailer

author: Jade King
description:
Gamers hoping for GTA 6 to amp up the realism when it comes to losing their wanted level in the sunny state of Leonida are in luck, with Rockstar confirming in a recent interview that Jason and Lucia can do far more than escape a glowing red zone on the map to shake off the law. 

Speaking to IGN ahead of the Netflix Extended Look back in August, head of development and co-studio head Rob Nelson walked the outlet through a 30-minute gameplay demo in which several new mechanics and locations were detailed.  

The demo begins in Jason and Lucia’s safehouse, one of many interactive personal spaces the player can call home in GTA 6. Here you can switch characters, partake in unique int
title: GTA 6 Wants Losing Your Wanted Level To Feel Like A “Hit-And-Run”

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
It's the start of a new month, and like clockwork, the next batch of Xbox Game Pass titles has been announced for the subscription service. Gears of War: E-Day leads the new arrivals this month, and it'll be joined by a few more big games: Battlefield 6 and Valor Mortis.

Here's a closer look at everything you can grab in the first half of the month through Xbox Game Pass:

The headline act is the aforementioned Gears of War: E-Day, a pretty great Xbox console exclusive if you're looking for something gleefully loud, dumb, and violent. Minecraft Dungeons 2 has also just l
title: Xbox Game Pass Gets Gears Of War: E-Day And These 11 Games In October

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
New information has come to light about GTA 6, and specifically the partnership of its main characters, Jason and Lucia. In GTA 6, they are both partners in crime and lovers, and physical intimacy will be part of the experience, it seems.

Rockstar North's Rob Nelson said in an interview with IGN that physical intimacy is a "huge part" of a relationship, and that applies to GTA 6. Exac
title: New Details Revealed For GTA 6’s Jason And Lucia, Including “Physical Intimacy”

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
Just a month after Microsoft said Forza Horizon 6 for PlayStation 5 remained on track to release in 2026, a new report says the game has in fact been delayed to 2027.

Reputable leaker billbil-kun said Forza Horizon 6 for PS5 is set for release on January 26, 2027. The report said there will be a physical disc edition at retail, and the game will also be sold digitally.

In September, Microsoft
title: Forza Horizon 6 For PS5 Apparently Delayed To 2027, And It’s Getting A Disc Release

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
After a lengthy hiatus, Gears of War returned this week to Xbox Series X|S and PC with a new adventure set during the cataclysmic events of Emergence Day. For fans of the series, it has been a long wait, as the previous entry in the series, Gears 5, was released all the way back in 2019. Will there be another seven-year stretch between new Gears games? Gears of War: E-Day developer The Coalition doesn't think so, as the new game lays the groundwork for a quicker turnaround for new potential chapters in the IP.

Speaking to the BBC, Coalition studio head Mike Crump said that E-Day provides a "great foundation" for future games, and he claimed that "the next game will not take nearly as long"
title: The Next Gears Of War Game Probably Won’t Need 7 Years To Cook

author: Mark Delaney
description:
Arc Raiders was an incredible game when it launched almost exactly one year ago. It joined Sea of Thieves and Left 4 Dead as one of my favorite co-op games ever. Many others loved it too, and it quickly surged to become one of 2025's best sellers and biggest stories. But in the months that followed, a large portion of players fell off the game's live-service carousel--or maybe "jumped off" is a better way to put it. 

Embark Studios announced in May that it was moving to semi-annual major updates to create a healthier environment for developers and players alike, as the monthly cadence began to feel li
title: Arc Raiders’ Huge Update Introduces Its Best Gadget Ever

author: Evan Campbell
description:
Stadia might be dead, but Google isn't giving up on gaming. The company has rolled out Playground, a platform built around AI that "lets you create, play, and share custom games." It's browser-based and labeled as an "experiment" to start. There's also Unity Spark support, which will offer more development options for people who catch the creator bug. 

Google's pitch claims that this new platform makes game creation more democratic by ending gatekeeping to development. The company states that Playground "lowers the barriers to creation, so bringing game ideas to life can now be as easy as describing it through a few prompts--no coding experience
title: Google Playground Wants Everyone To Make AI Games, And Maybe Everyone Shouldn’t

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
Rockstar boss Rob Nelson has stated that GTA 6 won't make players "all-powerful" like they were in GTA 5 and the games that came before it. For GTA 6, this means NPCs in the world will have impulses of their own, and could come after you.

Speaking to IGN, Nelson said, "The world will act upon you as well as you acting upon the world." In previous GTA games, except for the police, the player was the only one with an "invisible arsenal hidden away," and everyone in the world would run away in terror. "This world in GTA 6 is not like that," he said.</
title: GTA 6 Won’t Make You “All-Powerful” Like GTA 5 Did

author: Callum Self
description:
To many's surprise, Black Myth: Wukong turned out to be a great action-RPG when it launched in 2024. Drenched in a beautiful interpretation of Chinese mythology and an ambitious debut from Game Science, the stars aligned for it in a way that every developer entering the crowded space could hope for. If you haven't tried this excellent adventure with the Destined One, now's your chance, as it's cheaper than ever.

Inspired by the classic Chinese novel Journey to the West, you play as the Destined One, a mysterious monkey warrior tasked with recovering six relics tied to the senses of the legendary Sun Wukong. The Monkey King has been sealed in stone on Mount Huaguo for centuries, setting you off on a journey filled with mythical creatures, enormous bosses, and plenty of staff-based bonking.

Admittedly, for someone who has
title: Black Myth: Wukong Has Dropped To Its Lowest Price Yet, So Here’s Your Chance To Bonk Some Demons

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
After leaving the Xbox Game Studios portfolio, State of Decay 3 developer Undead Labs is now an independent, employee-owned studio. The developer had previously announced State of Decay 3 all the way back in 2020--partly to keep the project and the studio on Microsoft's radar--as the company embarked on an acquisition spree. Now one of several departures from Microsoft's gaming division following the bloody "Xbox reset" that has seen scores of jobs slashed throughout 2026, Undead Labs also had to cut staff as it entered a new era. But was there any behind-the-scenes drama that led to its exit from Xbox?

Speaking to
title: State Of Decay 3 Was Announced Early To Keep Undead Labs On Microsoft’s Radar

author: Richard Li
description: A huge number of smart ideas and great design lead to a lot of fun, fascinating puzzles, but the size of Order of the Sinking Star can make it overwhelming.
title: Order Of The Sinking Star Is Enormous, For Better And Worse – Review

author: Phil Hornshaw
description:
A good puzzle game needs to constantly find new ways to challenge you, to walk you through skills and reward your observations, and to contain answers that make logical sense without being too obvious, or too obtuse. 

Order of the Sinking Star, the latest puzzler from developer Thekla Interactive and director Jonathan Blow, mostly hits those marks with impressive, cunning, and devious puzzle design. But even when it misses and gets frustrating, the game takes so many swings that it's easy to  head to another level and find another opportunity to bend your brain and stretch your smarts.

In fact, the best and worst part of Order of the Sinking Star
title: Order Of The Sinking Star Sometimes Has Too Much Of A Great Thing

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
With Paramount's $111 billion acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery in the bag, details on what this merger means for the Warner Bros. game division have finally been revealed. Warner Bros. Interactive will merge with the newly formed Paramount Games Studio, and it'll oversee projects based on Skydance's rich--and newly acquired-library of IP. That lineup includes Avatar: The Last Airbender, South Park, Mortal Kombat, Game of Thrones, and Star Trek--and that's not even mentioning the treasure trove of DC Comics IP that the company now owns.

The new division will be overseen by Tony Driscoll, president of games and
title: Skydance Is Merging Paramount And Warner Bros.’ Game Studios Into One Unit

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
Resident Evil Requiem is one of this year's biggest hits, and Capcom plans to build on that success with new story DLC. While it hasn't yet revealed when it'll be out or what it's about, one of the game's writers, Haris Orkin, recently teased that the DLC will shed new light on Oswell E. Spencer, one of the biggest villains in the Resident Evil series.

"I think villains honestly are really fun to write, because I usually see every villain as a hero of their own story. So the villain is like in their mind they're a hero," Orkin said in an interview with the Distance Nerding podcast. I mean, Victor Gideon thinks he's going to save the world in Requiem. We have an arc for Spencer in Requiem. "Where you understand that more. And then in the
title: Resident Evil Requiem DLC Could Further Rewrite One Of The Series’ Biggest Villains

author: Cheri Faulkner
description:
Grand Theft Auto 6 is almost here. Well, almost here for console players, anyway. Rockstar's hugely anticipated open-world crime game is officially scheduled to launch on November 19, 2026, for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, but PC players will have to wait a little longer before they can dive in.

GTA 6 PC release date estimate

Our best guess for the GTA 6 PC release date is Q1 2028, putting the PC version roughly 15-18 months after the console launch. That's not based on a leak or any insider claim; instead we've looked at Rockstar's history of later PC release dates to inform our estimate.

That's earlier than the 19-month wait that PC players endured for GTA 5, and later than the 12-month gap betw
title: GTA 6 PC Release Date Estimate, Rumors, And News

author: Cheri Faulkner
description:
PC players hoping to find a way to play GTA 6 when it launches on consoles next month must be feeling pretty disappointed, as Microsoft has clarified that Grand Theft Auto 6 will not be available to stream to PC via Xbox Cloud Gaming. The news follows an earlier report claiming Xbox had secured exclusive streaming rights to Rockstar's highly anticipated game.

The clarification came from Xbox chief strategy officer Matthew Ball, who addressed The Verge's report. Ball said the excitement surrounding GTA 6 and Xbox had resulted in some inaccurate reporting.

His full statement read, "While the excitement for GTA 6 and Xbox is great to see, it has also led to some misreporting. We are looking forwa
title: GTA 6 Will Not Stream To PC Through Xbox, Despite Earlier Report
